content:
Newcomer declares war to the well known characters, and instantly fail
Zool ninja of the “nth” dimension: told sonic to move over in a magazine, after a couple of games he fell into obscurity.

  
40 winks conquer your fears: told Mario to move over in the game cover, I only know of this game because they did that.

  
Blinx the time sweeper: told both Mario and Sonic to prepare for war, I only remember him because of this and haven’t heard anything about his actual game. Didn’t even know it had a sequel.
